description: This file defines an internal class 'OracleCommandInterceptor' implementing the 'ICommandInterceptor' interface. It provides functionality to modify Oracle database commands, specifically setting properties like 'BindByName' and 'OracleDbType' for parameters such as Clob, Blob, and Boolean types. The class uses expression trees to build and compile these property setters efficiently at runtime.

classes.name: OracleCommandInterceptor
classes.description: Internal class implementing ICommandInterceptor to customize Oracle DB commands; sets parameters' type and bind properties for Oracle command execution.

methods.name: BuildSetBindByNameAction
methods.description: Creates a delegate to set the 'BindByName' property of an OracleCommand to true, using expression trees.

methods.name: BuildSetOracleDbTypeAction
methods.description: Creates a delegate to set the 'OracleDbType' property of an OracleParameter to a specified enum value, using expression trees.

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: Modifies the given IDbCommand by setting 'BindByName' to true, and adjusting parameter types based on parameter names such as 'PayloadJson', 'PayloadXml', 'PayloadBinary', and boolean conversions.
